description: A lab-local clickjacking: the lab settings page renders inside a foreign iframe with no X-Frame-Options header and no CSP frame-ancestors, so a victim click can be hijacked.

evidence.notes: Lab-local fixture traffic only; the framing page is a lab stub
evidence.response: 200 OK, no X-Frame-Options header, no Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directive; the page renders inside an <iframe> on https://lab.evil.test/

impact: An attacker could trick a lab user into clicking a hidden settings action.
proof_of_concept: Load https://lab.local/settings inside an <iframe> on an attacker page; the settings form renders and a click on the visible decoy button lands on the hidden Save button.
remediation: Send X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN) and a Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directive on every page.
steps_to_reproduce: Host a page with an <iframe src="https://lab.local/settings">
Overlay a decoy button on the framed Save button
Observe the settings page rendering inside the frame and a click landing on Save
title: Clickjacking in lab settings page
